description:
Return the organization's API and Vibe budgets for the current billing period.

Requires the `see_org_inference_usage` permission.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the budget (e.g. EUR, USD). The applicable budget is lazily materialized for the requested period, so this is only null when no budget could be derived.
currency.title: Currency

initial_budget.description: Initial budget allocated for the billing period, expressed in the budget currency.
initial_budget.title: Initial Budget

payg_enabled.description: Whether pay-as-you-go overage is enabled for this budget type. Only meaningful for the Vibe budget.
payg_enabled.title: Payg Enabled

reset_at.description: Timestamp at which the requested billing period resets (start of the next period).
reset_at.title: Reset At

usage_percentage.description: Percentage of the budget consumed for the requested billing period (0-100).
usage_percentage.title: Usage Percentage
